Doctor.disclaimer: Note: The AI does not prescribe autonomously. All prescriptions require doctor confirmation.

Doctor.tourSearchDesc: Quickly find a patient by name or filter the list based on risk status.
Doctor.tourFlagsDesc: Pay attention to these flags. 'Bipolar Flag' warns of mania risks, and 'Conflict' means the AI found a contradiction in the patient's records.

Forms.title: PHQ-9 Depression Scale
Forms.subtitle: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by:
Forms.q2: Little interest or pleasure in doing things?
Forms.q3: Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much?
Forms.q4: Feeling tired or having little energy?
Forms.q6: Feeling bad about yourself — or that you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down?
Forms.q7: Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading the newspaper or watching television?
Forms.q8: Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed? Or the opposite — being so fidgety or restless that you have been moving around a lot more than usual?

Alerts.title: CRITICAL ALERT
Alerts.description: A patient has triggered a safety flag during their latest assessment and shows abnormal physiological stress markers (Elevated EDA, Dropping HRV).
Alerts.disclaimer: Alerts are generated based on validated clinical thresholds. The clinician retains full responsibility for patient routing and care.
